tei:div.tei:p: yig tshang mkhas pa dga' byed kyi mdzad byang*/ smon lam

bzhugs so/ / oṃ swa sti/ rgyal ba'i bka' dang bstan 'dzin skyes bu yis/ /dgongs bzhed dang mthun 'dzam gling shas che ba'i/ /lo paṇa mkhas grub chos rgyal rim pa dang*/ /stobs ldan rnams kyi thub bstan rgyas pa'i thabs/ /sna tshogs spel mdzad rnam thar bsgrigs pa yis/ /legs bshad mkhas pa dga' byed yig tshang 'di| |yig mkhan shākya'i dge snyen shrī bhu ti/ /bha dra'i ming can g.yas ru stag tshang pa'i/ /shing pho stag la stag sna don rtser bkod/ /'di'i dge ba rab dkar dri med des/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang*/ /'gro kun bla med byang chub myur thob shog /sngon chad bod 'dir mkhas mang gis bsdebs pa'i/ / yig tshang yig tshogs rgyas pa mang mod kyi/ /de dag kun kyang rin chen gser dang mtshungs/ /tshig gi nor bu rdog bsdus yig ge'i 'bru/ /dag gsal srad bur brgyus pa'i yig tshang mchog /mdor bsdus don gsal 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser| |ji bzhin mkhas pa'i khyad nor 'di 'dra dkon/ /skal ldan dga' spro spel ba'i rgyur gyur cig /'di don mthong thos dran pa'i skyes bu kun/ /chos rgyal yon mchod rnams la sems dad cing*/ /sangs rgyas bstan la mchog tu mos pa dang | | rang gzhan dge la bskul ba'i rgyur gyur cig /mkhas mang rgyu skar dbus na nyi ma bzhin/ /gzhan phan 'od stong 'gyed pa'i yig tshang 'dis/ /blo ngan mun nag rab rib phyir bsal nas/ /blo gros pad tshal rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig | blo gsal ri dgas gtso bo gdong lnga bzhin/ /smra ba'i phyogs la mi 'jigs yig tshang 'dis/ /ltas ngan wa skyes tshogs rnams zil mnan nas/ / phas rgol spobs pa 'joms pa'i rgyur gyur cig /zab yang rgya mtsho'i skye bo'i khrod na da ེ da dpon bzhin/ /gang la ci 'dod ster ba'i yig tshang 'dis/ /blun rmongs dbul ba'i sdug bsngal kun gsal nas/ /'dod dgu'i gter kha 'byed pa'i rgyur gyur cig

/nor 'tshol skye bo'i khrod na ded dpon bzhin/ /thabs mkhas gru chen ldan pa'i yig tshang 'dis/ /'gro mang phan bde'i rlung gis rab bskyod nas/ /thar pa'i lam mchog stsol ba'i rgyur gyur cig /dge ba'i bsam pas phyogs kun mtha' dag nas/ /zab bsdus legs par bsgrigs pa'i yig tshang 'dis/ /mkha' ltar khyab nas bstan pa'i bya ba kun/ /sgrub pa'i dmigs rkyain byed pa'i rgyur gyur cig /phyogs gcig 'dus na 'dod dgu'i gter mdzod dang | | so sor 'thor na'ang rin chen ras ma bzhin/ /gang ltar gyur kyang phan byed yig tshang 'di/ /'gro mang dge la bskul ba'i rgyur gyur cig /'dod dgu'i bang mdzod legs bshad rgyan gyi spras/ /ngo mtshar gtam rgyud 'phreng ba'i bra phyed 'phyangs | | sangs rgyas byon tshul tog gi nyer mdzes pa'i/ khang bzangs kun 'dzoms de'i phyogs bzhi ru/ /da lta'i skabs na bstan pa'i srog shing 'dzin/ / snyigs dus 'gro mgon chos rgya rab brtan gyis/ /rnam thar nor bu'i rgyal mtshan cher btsugs nas/ /snyan grags ba dan g.yo ba'i rgyur gyur cig/ mdor na bstan dang 'gro la phan phyir du/ /lhag bsam rnam par dag pas bkod pa dang*/ /bla med dkon mchog gsum gyi bdain pa'i mthus/ /ji ltar smon pa yid bzhin 'grub gyur cig /smra ba'i seng ge 'jam dbyang mgon po'i sku | | mtshan dpe'i gzi 'od 'khor tshogs sku tshe'i tshad/ /zhing khams 'phrin las bzang po ci 'dra ba/ /de 'dra kho nar bdag sogs 'jug gyur gcig phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dge legs chen po'i dpal gyis kun nas kun tu 'byor cing khyab gyur cig bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ smon lam thams cad yongs su grub pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tad+ya thā/ oṃ dha ra dha ra bhan dha re swā hā/ zhes pa lan gcig brjod pas/ rang dang gzhan gyi don du/ smon lam btab pa thams cad gdon mi za bar 'grub par 'gyur ro/

/zhes mdo sde nas gsal bar gsungs so/ /dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig rgya gar rgya nag li yul kha ba can/ /zas gtsang la sogs rgyal rabs mang po dang*/ /sa skya'i gdung rabs la sogs gangs can du*/ /bla rabs byon tshul mdzad 'phrin deb gter 'di| |bstan la rab 'byams bho dhi dho dz+wa yis/ /lhag bsam rnam par dag pas myur bar bris/ /'di bris pa las dge ba gang thob des/ /'gro la 'khor ba'i g.yang sa rab bkag nas/ /sa dang lam gyi spangs rtaugs myur rdzogs te/ / bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa thob phyir bsngo/ /dge'o/ /bkra shis// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ yig tshang mkhas pa dga' byed/yig tshang gi mdzad byang dang smon lam/ -PAGE 304--PAGE 303-
